rationale: The report explicitly requires one hit per enemy per direction, independent of step size. Original source sets orb damage to 100 + 0.5*AP: with AP 0 and MR 100, one outward magic hit deals 50 and one returning true-damage hit deals 100. These preserve existing per-hit balance, yielding 150 total damage. All setup occurs before casting. The trace reproduces excess damage: fine steps deal 450 outward and 1650 total; coarse steps deal 300 total. StepShots clears the hit set on collision without adding the victim, permitting repeated overlap hits. Retained damage and off-path controls directly witness the report; equality across step sizes alone would also accept equally broken results. These checks cover the supplied stationary-target scenario, not all enemies or step sizes.

checks.label: Fine outward deals exactly one existing magic hit
Fine return deals exactly one existing true-damage hit
Coarse outward deals exactly one existing magic hit
Coarse return deals exactly one existing true-damage hit
Completed damage agrees across tested step sizes
